lessons.program_rule: Fixture data never masquerades as analysis of user data; modes and result provenance are persistent.
lessons.rationale: The prototype demonstrated a P0 false causal claim.

lessons.program_rule: Definition, preflight, semantic, mapping/schema, approval, execution, outcome and cleanup failures have distinct owners and stop behavior.
lessons.rationale: One generic failure is neither truthful nor recoverable.

lessons.program_rule: Only current-run evidence may identify a causal block; uncertainty is explicit.
lessons.rationale: Graph position is not causal evidence.

lessons.program_rule: The product must support a generic typed multimodal request outcome; the exact single-primitive UI is revalidated in its feature spec.
lessons.rationale: The semantic need is durable but the prototype UI primitive is not production-approved.
lessons.due_gate: EPP-F02 or later authoring feature planning

lessons.program_rule: Presence/type/readability preflight and consuming-task semantic sufficiency remain separate.
lessons.rationale: Input blocks cannot infer downstream semantic requirements.

lessons.program_rule: Exact reviewed tool identity and schema precede AI argument generation.
lessons.rationale: Friendly capability metadata cannot supply an executable contract.

lessons.program_rule: Every executable step exposes bounded inputs, outputs, provenance, activity and diagnosis.
lessons.rationale: A completed badge without evidence is not credible.

lessons.program_rule: Validate-only, fixture, unconnected and live modes are explicit in all projections and evidence.
lessons.rationale: A badge alone did not prevent simulation from being read as analysis.

lessons.program_rule: Every non-success result has bounded layer-appropriate recovery or explicit external intervention.
lessons.rationale: Generic red states did not tell users what to change.

lessons.program_rule: UI/code/CLI/headless views project one canonical definition; immutable run records alone own execution state.
lessons.rationale: Visual fixtures could invent states no interpreter produced.

lessons.program_rule: Fast pure/component/contract tests are the default loop and qualified human review remains mandatory for trust/usability claims.
lessons.rationale: Tests passed while hands-on review exposed misleading behavior; overloaded suites also produced isolation failures.

lessons.program_rule: Preflight enforces only explicit canonical or exact-contract requirements with visible provenance.
lessons.rationale: Prompt wording was silently promoted into a hidden fixture requirement.

lessons.program_rule: A canonical request preserves typed artifacts and compatible typed views; the number and visual form of input blocks remain feature-level UX decisions.
lessons.rationale: Typed routing is a durable invariant, but a single primitive for every workflow is not proven.

lessons.program_rule: Model configuration is immutable per run and tool isolation is a separate evidence-backed capability; unsupported selections fail explicitly.
lessons.rationale: Per-request model lock worked, while no-Wright-MCP did not prove no tools of any kind.

lessons.program_rule: Long-running steps expose durable activity, elapsed/last activity, partial-output status, cancel, separate deadlines, reconnect and bounded cleanup.
lessons.rationale: A generic Running state hid provider silence and stale configuration.

lessons.program_rule: Installed server discovery and exact executable tool binding are separate reviewed choices; broad domains never auto-bind.
lessons.rationale: One server exposes many tools and context was insufficient for a safe default.

lessons.program_rule: Code/text and diagram share one semantic model with stable identities and invalid-edit protection; syntax and Apply interaction require DEC-P0-002.
lessons.rationale: The invariant is accepted; strict JSON and the prototype interaction remain provisional.

lessons.program_rule: Run state distinguishes registration, connection, first event, first output, terminal outcome and cleanup with typed failures.
lessons.rationale: Running only proved the last observed boundary, not end-to-end liveness.

lessons.program_rule: Consumer tool/schema and required mappings are ready before producer argument generation or invocation.
lessons.rationale: Healthy prose output and a selected object-input tool still formed an impossible workflow.

lessons.program_rule: Execution is UI-independent and UI/headless paths require declared equivalence; application-backed work additionally requires authoritative identity/exclusivity and independent engineering oracles.
lessons.rationale: Headless execution passed orchestration but competing surfaces returned inconsistent models and no engineering correctness was proven.

lessons.program_rule: Use tool-independent semantic artifacts plus deterministic adapters when they improve portability and validation; direct schema-bound values remain permitted when explicitly reviewed.
lessons.rationale: Application-internal payload generation failed in the prototype, but a universal semantic intermediary may not fit every exact tool.

lessons.program_rule: Primary actions describe stable user actions; topology, status and failure details appear in progress/diagnosis.
lessons.rationale: Fixture-specific labels made controls harder to understand and generalize.

lessons.program_rule: Engineer-facing results lead with state, consequence, output and recovery while preserving exact technical evidence behind disclosure.
lessons.rationale: Raw timestamps/errors/JSON obscured the useful result.

lessons.program_rule: Successful runs expose accurate actionable typed outputs with producer provenance, lifetime, actions and cleanup.
lessons.rationale: A green run did not let the user identify or open the produced model.

lessons.program_rule: Ports, connections, runtime values/artifacts and reusable component interfaces are distinct canonical concepts; visual notation and composition UX require fresh usability evidence.
lessons.rationale: Prototype artifact-placement concepts exposed overload but did not select a production UI.
